**ON THE UNIFICATION OF QUANTUM 3–MANIFOLD INVARIANTS**

*ANNA BELIAKOVA AND THANG LE*

18 pp, 27 sections.

**Abstract.** In 2006 Habiro initiated a construction of generating functions for Witten– Reshetikhin–Turaev (WRT) invariants known as uniﬁed WRT invariants. In a series of papers together with Irmgard B¨uhler and Christian Blanchet we extended his construc- tion to a larger class of 3–manifolds. The uniﬁed invariants provide a strong tool to study properties of the whole collection of WRT invariants, e.g. their integrality, and hence, their categoriﬁcation. In this paper we give a survey on ideas and techniques used in the construction of the uniﬁed invariants.

**Outline.** Front matter; Introduction; Background; Unified invariants of integral homology 3–sphe; Unified invariants of rational homology 3–sphe; 1 Quantum (WRT) invariants; 1.1 Notations and conventions; 1.2 The colored Jones polynomial; 1.3 Kirby moves; 1.4 Evaluation and Gauss sums; 1.5 Definition of the WRT invariants; 1.6 Habiro's cyclotomic expansion of the color; 2 Main Results; 2.2 Laplace transform; 2.1 Strategy of the proof; 2.3 Definition of the unified invariant: diago; 2.4 Diagonalization using lens spaces; 3 Cyclotomic completions of polynomial rings
